name: @deckgauge/shared
//type: ESM, like every other Node-executed package here. As CJS this barrel reached apps/api and apps/worker (both type: module) through Node's CJS-ESM interop, where cjs-module-lexer has to recover the named exports from tsx's transpiled output. Node 20 manages it; Node 24 recovers NONE of the 487, collapsing the namespace to `default` + `module.exports`, so every `import { X } from '@deckgauge/shared'` fails at instantiation — 108 of them across the two apps. The images pin node:20-slim, which is the only reason staging boots. Guarded by apps/api/src/timesheet/shared-esm-exports.test.ts.
